title: How to import a Funnel From ClickFunnels?
html:
The ClickFunnels to KenjiAI importer is useful for individuals or businesses looking to switch from ClickFunnels to KenjiAI and want to migrate their existing funnels and pages without rebuilding them from scratch. It could save significant time and effort, particularly for those with many funnels or pages to transfer.

Please Note:

- This imported will work for both ClickFunnels 1.0 & ClickFunnels 2.0 Funnels.

- Please ensure that you utilize the publishable (live) link, and not the shareable click funnel link. It's essential to import one Funnel Step at a time from ClickFunnels for a seamless experience.

  • Step 2: Click on Funnels
  • Step 3: Click on "New Funnel"
  • Step 4: Click on "Add a new step

Please Note: ClickFunnels Membership Areas do not import using the funnel share URL. The KenjiAI importer only transfers standard funnel pages (opt-ins, sales, thank-you, etc.) If your ClickFunnels funnel includes a Members Area, you'll need to rebuild it manually using KenjiAI's Memberships tool, which you can find in the main left-side navigation bar named Memberships.
